title: 第二十一章 戳破根底第二十二章 真的假的
content_zh:
清晨，宋风早早的起来穿上了那一身淡青色的道袍，将原本准备好的法衣堆叠好，放在了自家准备的一个布包里。
早上先对着大日吞吐呼吸。
现如今许多人还没醒呢，但是宋风他们师徒三个人却早早的起来，找到了一处空旷的地方，各自开始习练养生功法，练习吐纳气机。
宋风如今这一身老骨头没有以前那么结实，不适合练一些年轻人的抻筋拔骨的力道，反倒更应当养养气血。
于是在修行完八段锦之后，他则是停下了手中的动作，取来了一碗早已准备好的茶水深深的喝了一口。
喝完茶水后，他则是站在旁边吐纳气息，看起来跟平常无恙，其实内里的气机已经逐渐充盈；
“这周天混元吐息法果然是一门了不得的吐纳之术，仅仅只是气息充盈便以如此奇妙，若是真的达到了神完气足的境地，又该如何？”
一边喝着茶水宋风一边看着两个徒弟在那锻炼修行，等到两个徒弟各自忙完后，也是将茶水递给他们。
师徒三个人一边喝着水一边聊着天，现如今真正起来忙的人还不多，足以让师徒三个人缓缓劲。
“师父，我们跟着几个老爷子一起玩儿可好了，根本不需干别的事情，只需要跟着人拍拍照吃点喝点就行了。”
一说到跟着去提前演练的时候，老二宋志心中就有些激动，看起来似乎是很快乐似的。
甚至一边讲着，老二还一边开口说着那摄影机是多么的奇妙，拍出来的照片又是多么的像，甚至颜色都一模一样。
三个人聊了一会儿，宋风又指点了一下师兄弟两个人的吐纳之术，随即也是各自离去。
老二还得跟着那五个老爷子忙去呢。
各处都有着验收，这一次海城这边的这些人可是真的把这件事情放在心上，可不容许出现任何意外。
用过早饭。
师徒两个人则是已经来到了早就已经准备好的那一个房子里面，仔细看上去，只看到那房间里此刻不仅架着一个油锅，甚至还放着许多由锋利的刀剑铸成的一个钉板似的东西。
刀锋都向上，有的平有的高有的缓。
这玩意儿看起来没有普遍意义上的刀山的样子，但是谁估计都不敢踩在上面。
而刀山附近则是放着许多炭火，炭火堆成一堆现如今还没点燃呢，但仅仅只是一看就让人不明觉厉。

“老大，把油锅烧上，把火炭点好，今天人家来验收，咱们也不能让人家觉得事情办的不地道。”
撸起袖子，宋风深吸几口气，把气息喘匀称了，随即招呼着老大宋诚把该烧的东西都烧上，好歹也是来验收的得让人家心中有个谱。
听到了老爷子如此说，宋诚则是认真的点了点头，随即将油锅下面的柴火点上，也将那长长的足够有将近十米的煤炭堆积而成的道路点好。
不一会儿整个空房子里温度瞬间上升。
老大宋诚在煽风点火的时候似乎早就已经习惯了这个温度，身体素质倒也不差，所以倒也没有太多的汗水流出。
还没等两个人待多长时间。
只看到原本已经消失了一天的赵总，连带着他的秘书小陈，后面跟着七八个人一起来到了这一处地方。
来到这一处地方，王卫国看着此地的这诸多场景也是感觉有些奇异，毕竟这温度烧的是真旺。
content_en:
In the early morning, Song Feng got up early and put on the light cyan robe. He stacked the robes he had prepared and put them in a cloth bag prepared by himself.
In the morning, breathe in and out facing the sun.
Many people haven't woken up yet, but Song Feng and his three masters and apprentices got up early, found an open place, and each began to practice health-preserving techniques and breathing in and out of qi.
Song Feng's old bones are not as strong as before. He is not suitable for practicing the strength of some young people, such as stretching muscles and pulling out bones. On the contrary, he should nourish his energy and blood.
So after finishing practicing Baduanjin, he stopped what he was doing, took a bowl of tea that had been prepared and took a deep sip.
After drinking the tea, he stood beside him and breathed out his breath. He seemed to be fine as usual, but in fact, the energy inside him had gradually filled up;
"This Zhou Tian Hunyuan Breathing Technique is indeed an incredible breathing technique. Just filling the breath is so wonderful. What if it really reaches the state of complete spiritual energy?"
While drinking tea, Song Feng watched the two apprentices practicing there. After the two apprentices finished their work, he handed them the tea.
The master and the apprentice were chatting while drinking water. Not many people were really busy at the moment, which was enough for the master and the apprentice to relax.
"Master, let's play with a few old men. We don't need to do anything else. We just need to take pictures, eat and drink with them."
When it came to following him to practice in advance, the second child Song Zhi felt a little excited and seemed to be very happy.
Even while talking, the second child started talking about how wonderful the camera was and how similar the photos it took were, even the colors were exactly the same.
The three of them chatted for a while, and Song Feng gave the two brothers some pointers on the art of breathing and breathing, and then they left separately.
The second child still has to follow the five old men.
There are inspections everywhere. This time, these people in Haicheng really take this matter to heart and do not allow any accidents.
Had breakfast.
The two masters and apprentices had already arrived at the house that had been prepared for a long time. Looking carefully, they saw that there was not only a frying pan in the room, but also many nail-like things made of sharp swords.
The blades all point upward, some are flat, some are high, and some are gentle.
This thing doesn't look like a mountain of swords in the general sense, but no one would dare to step on it.
There are many charcoal fires placed near Knife Mountain. The charcoal fires are piled up in a pile and have not been lit yet, but just looking at them makes people confused.
"Boss, put on the oil pan and light the charcoal. People are here to check and accept it today. We can't let people think that things are not done properly."
Rolling up his sleeves, Song Feng took a few deep breaths to breathe evenly, and then asked his boss Song Cheng to burn all the things that should be burned. After all, he was here for inspection and acceptance, so that everyone would have a certain score in his mind.
After hearing what the old man said, Song Cheng nodded seriously, then lit the firewood under the oil pot and lit the road that was long enough to have nearly ten meters of coal piled up.
After a while, the temperature in the entire empty house rose instantly.
The boss, Song Cheng, seemed to have been accustomed to the temperature when he was fanning the flames. His physical fitness was not bad, so he didn't sweat too much.
It didn't take long for the two of them to stay together.
I only saw Mr. Zhao, who had disappeared for a day, arriving at this place together with his secretary Xiao Chen, followed by seven or eight people.
When Wang Weiguo came to this place, he felt a little strange looking at the many scenes here. After all, the temperature was really hot.
